evidence: the marker list has cell types only the built-in small_intestine list has: BEST4+ enterocytes, Enterocytes, M cells, Paneth cells

priors.title: Epithelial cells lie in the mucosa (villi and crypts). The one normal exception is the duodenal Brunner's glands in the submucosa.
priors.short: Epithelial cells lie in the mucosa (villi and crypts).
rules: kind=region, types=[Epithelial], regions=[mucosa, Brunner's glands], mode=only, strength=strong

priors.title: Paneth cells sit only at the crypt base, intercalated with LGR5+ Stem cells. They are not on the villi.
priors.short: Paneth cells sit only at the crypt base, intercalated with LGR5+ Stem cells.
rules: kind=region, types=[Paneth cells], regions=[crypts], mode=only, strength=strong
kind=region, types=[Paneth cells], regions=[villi], mode=exclude, strength=strong

priors.title: Stem cells (LGR5+/OLFM4+) are restricted to the crypt base. Cycling TAs fill the lower and middle crypt. Neither is on the villi.
priors.short: Stem cells (LGR5+/OLFM4+) are restricted to the crypt base.
rules: kind=region, types=[Stem cells, Cycling TAs], regions=[villi], mode=exclude, strength=strong

priors.title: Enterocytes are the villus cell type, and their programmes are zoned along the villus axis.
priors.short: Enterocytes are the villus cell type, and their programmes are zoned along the villus axis.

priors.title: Goblet cells, Enteroendocrine cells, Tuft cells and BEST4+ enterocytes are scattered single cells inside the epithelium. Enteroendocrine hormone content changes along the crypt-villus axis.
priors.short: Goblet cells, Enteroendocrine cells, Tuft cells and BEST4+ enterocytes are scattered single cells inside the epithelium.
rules: kind=neighborhood, types=[Goblet cells, Enteroendocrine cells, Tuft cells, BEST4+ enterocytes], neighbor_types=[Epithelial], min_frac=0.3, mode=only, strength=moderate

priors.title: M cells occur only in the follicle-associated epithelium over Peyer's patches and isolated lymphoid follicles. They make up about 10% of follicle-associated epithelium cells. They are not in the ordinary villus epithelium.
priors.short: M cells occur only in the follicle-associated epithelium over Peyer's patches and isolated lymphoid follicles.
rules: kind=region, types=[M cells], regions=[follicle-associated epithelium, Peyer's patch, lymphoid follicle], mode=only, strength=strong

priors.title: B cells are concentrated in Peyer's patches and lymphoid follicles. Peyer's patches occur mainly in the ileum, and the follicles span the mucosa and the submucosa.
priors.short: B cells are concentrated in Peyer's patches and lymphoid follicles.
rules: kind=region, types=[B cells], regions=[Peyer's patch, lymphoid follicle], mode=enrich, strength=strong

priors.title: The small intestine has many intraepithelial lymphocytes. Normal duodenum has about 11 (up to about 25) per 100 villus epithelial cells. Nearly all are T cells, mostly CD8 T cells and gd T cells, and there are more of them than in the colon.
priors.short: The small intestine has many intraepithelial lymphocytes.
rules: kind=neighborhood, types=[CD8 T cells, gd T cells], neighbor_types=[Epithelial], min_frac=0.6, mode=enrich, strength=moderate
kind=neighborhood, types=[Naive CD4 T cells, B cells], neighbor_types=[Epithelial], min_frac=0.6, mode=exclude, strength=weak

priors.title: Plasma cells, Macrophages and most Dendritic cells fill the lamina propria of the villus cores and between the crypts.
priors.short: Plasma cells, Macrophages and most Dendritic cells fill the lamina propria of the villus cores and between the crypts.
rules: kind=region, types=[Plasma cells], regions=[mucosa], mode=enrich, strength=moderate

priors.title: Lymphatic EC include the central lacteal in every villus core, so lymphatics ARE expected in the small-intestinal mucosa, unlike the colon. Smooth muscle strands also run up the villus core along the lacteal.
priors.short: Lymphatic EC include the central lacteal in every villus core, so lymphatics ARE expected in the small-intestinal mucosa, unlike the colon.
rules: kind=region, types=[Lymphatic EC], regions=[villi, submucosa], mode=enrich, strength=weak

priors.title: Smooth muscle cells mainly form the muscularis propria (inner circular and outer longitudinal) and the muscularis mucosae.
priors.short: Smooth muscle cells mainly form the muscularis propria (inner circular and outer longitudinal) and the muscularis mucosae.
rules: kind=region, types=[Smooth muscle cells], regions=[muscularis propria], mode=enrich, strength=moderate

priors.title: Neurons are only in the submucosal and myenteric ganglia. Glia occur in all layers, including the mucosa.
priors.short: Neurons are only in the submucosal and myenteric ganglia.
rules: kind=region, types=[Neurons], regions=[submucosa, muscularis propria, myenteric plexus], mode=only, strength=moderate
kind=region, types=[Neurons, Glia], regions=[myenteric plexus], mode=enrich, strength=strong

priors.title: ICC are confined to the muscularis propria. In the small intestine this includes the myenteric plexus level and the deep muscular plexus inside the circular muscle.
priors.short: ICC are confined to the muscularis propria.
rules: kind=region, types=[ICC], regions=[muscularis propria, myenteric plexus], mode=only, strength=moderate
